properties.description: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).
The run output follows the qualified permissive.
Raw loss or E-stop stops immediately.
A lost permissive clears qualification history; future qualification must be rebuilt.
Only enabled intervals are accumulated in a long time type.
A continuously permitted demand eventually starts under advancing time. Explicit non-Zeno environment premise: physical elapsed time crosses infinitely many 1ms boundaries.

atomic_propositions.qualified: Continuous permitted raw TRUE duration >= DebounceTime, with first sampled TRUE at elapsed zero.
atomic_propositions.accPrev: {"kind": "previous_observed_output", "source": "O[k-1].PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC", "initial": "LTIME#0ns", "update": "After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC; never write into reference state."}
atomic_propositions.accNext: O[k].PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC, actual post-scan LTIME; never reference accumulator.
atomic_propositions.interface names: Identically named sampled input or end-of-scan output.
atomic_propositions.TimeTick: Boolean: floor(t[k]/1ms)>floor(t[k-1]/1ms), with t[0]=0, TimeTick[0]=FALSE, t[k]=sum(dt_ms[1..k]). G(F(TimeTick)) states unbounded physical time progress; merely positive dt is insufficient.
atomic_propositions.VFD_RUN: O[k].VFD_RUN: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.PUMP_MAINT_DUE: O[k].PUMP_MAINT_DUE: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC: O[k].PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC: independently observed post-scan candidate value (LTIME); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.VFD_RUN=false, O_init.PUMP_MAINT_DUE=false, O_init.PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC="LTIME#0ns".
